title: Idea box: optional name in the issue, and Tab works through the form
body:
## What changes
- **Optional name:** a "Your name (optional)" field under the idea. When filled in, the issue footer says *"Sent from the map's idea box by **Sam from Delridge**"*, and the thank-you says *"Thank you, Sam from Delridge!"*. Left blank, the idea stays anonymous as before.
- **Keyboard:** the box is now a real `<form>`.
  - Tab runs idea → name → captcha → SEND IDEA → CANCEL → ✕ and wraps round, so focus never lands on the map behind. Shift+Tab goes the other way. SEND is skipped while it's disabled.
  - Enter in the name field sends. Enter in the idea still adds a new line, and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends from anywhere.
  - The ✕ moved to the end of the tab order and is still drawn in the top corner.
- **Worker:** takes `name` (one line, ≤ 60 characters, `@mentions` and Markdown defused). Over 60 is refused with a message.

## Copy (in `src/content/ideas.ts`, Mike's to rewrite)
- "Ideas are posted publicly, with no name attached." → "Ideas are posted publicly on GitHub." (a name can now be attached)
- New: "Your name (optional)" · "Shown with your idea. Leave it blank to stay anonymous." · placeholder "e.g. Sam from Delridge"

## Tests
- Unit: 2 new tests for name handling (250 total, all green). `cd wish && npm test` checks the name is credited.
- Chrome against a local Worker and fake GitHub: Tab order recorded step by step, including the wrap both ways; Enter in the name field sent the idea; the thank-you and the issue footer showed the name.
- `npm run build` and `npm run smoke` are green.

## After merge
Deploy `wish/` (the old Worker ignores `name`, so ideas just arrive without it until then).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

commits.message:
Idea box: optional name, credited in the issue; Tab order wraps inside the box

The box is now a real form: idea → name → captcha → SEND → CANCEL → ✕, wrapping round so
focus never lands on the map behind; Enter in the name field sends. The Worker takes an
optional one-line name (≤ 60, mentions and Markdown defused) and credits it in the issue
footer; "Thank you, <name>!" when given. Copy now says ideas are public on GitHub, name
optional.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
